input.query: SELECT date_trunc('week', event_date) week, platform, doc_type, COUNT(*) attempts, AVG(CASE WHEN is_kyc_approved THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) approval_rate FROM fct_kyc_attempts WHERE channel='organic' AND event_date >= DATE '2026-03-01' AND event_date < DATE '2026-05-01' GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3
